2751.def:
let DeviceCodeSignIns = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | extend AuthDetailsStr = tostring(AuthenticationDetails)
    | where AuthDetailsStr has "deviceCode" or AuthenticationRequirement has "deviceCode"
    | project DeviceCodeTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Application;
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","UpdateInboxRules")
| extend RuleDetails = tostring(RawEventData)
| where RuleDetails has_any ("DeleteMessage","MoveToFolder","ForwardTo","RedirectTo","MarkAsRead")
   or RuleDetails has_any ("RSS Feeds","Archive","Conversation History",".. ","!")
| join kind=inner DeviceCodeSignIns on $left.AccountDisplayName == $right.AccountUpn
| where Timestamp between (DeviceCodeTime .. DeviceCodeTime + 60m)
| extend DelayMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, DeviceCodeTime)
| project DeviceCodeTime, RuleCreatedTime = Timestamp, DelayMinutes, AccountDisplayName, IPAddress, Application, ActionType, ObjectName, RuleDetails
| order by RuleCreatedTime desc
2751.sent:
let DeviceCodeSignIns = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | extend AuthDetailsStr = tostring(AuthenticationDetails)
    | where AuthDetailsStr has "deviceCode" or AuthenticationRequirement has "deviceCode"
    | project DeviceCodeTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName = tolower(UserPrincipalName), IPAddress, AppDisplayName, OriginalRequestId;
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Operation in ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","UpdateInboxRules")
| extend UserPrincipalName = tolower(UserId)
| where Parameters has_any ("DeleteMessage","MoveToFolder","ForwardTo","RedirectTo","MarkAsRead")
| join kind=inner DeviceCodeSignIns on UserPrincipalName
| where TimeGenerated between (DeviceCodeTime .. DeviceCodeTime + 60m)
| extend DelayMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, DeviceCodeTime)
| project DeviceCodeTime, RuleCreatedTime = TimeGenerated, DelayMinutes, UserPrincipalName, ClientIP, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, Operation, Parameters
| order by RuleCreatedTime desc
2751.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` min(_time) as deviceCodeTime from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success Authentication.signature="deviceCode" by Authentication.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)` | join type=inner user [ | tstats `summariesonly` min(_time) as ruleTime from datamodel=Change where Change.action=created Change.object_category="InboxRule" by Change.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Change)` | rename Change.user as user ] | eval diff_sec=ruleTime-deviceCodeTime | where diff_sec>=0 AND diff_sec<=3600 | convert ctime(deviceCodeTime) ctime(ruleTime)
2751.datadog: source:office365 @evt.name:("New-InboxRule" OR "Set-InboxRule" OR "UpdateInboxRules") @Parameters:(*DeleteMessage* OR *MoveToFolder* OR *ForwardTo* OR *RedirectTo*)

// Article-specific bespoke detection — ShinyHunters Exploits Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day (CVE-2026-35273) to Breach Univ
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("_fanout.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/etc/hosts") or FileName in~ ("_fanout.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2798.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — ShinyHunters Exploits Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day (CVE-2026-35273) to Breach Univ ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("_fanout.sh"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/etc/hosts*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("_fanout.sh"))

| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

     | where scStatus == 200

     | where ScStatus == 200
     | project AdminTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIp = CIp, AdminUri = CsUriStem,
               UA = UserAgent, Host = CsHost);

  union isfuzzy=true
    (W3CIISLog
     | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours + 1h)
     | where csUriStem in ("/api/v1/login", "/api/v1/auth/login", "/login", "/oauth/token")

     | project LoginTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIp = CIp);
AdminHits

         and datetime_diff('second', AdminTime, LoginTime) between (0 .. LoginWindowSec)

DeviceFileEvents

title: Miasma Phantom Gyp - Python gyp parser spawning Node payload via binding.gyp
id: 7f3b6c2a-d4e1-4a01-9c5e-3a4f1c8e7b22
description: Detects node-gyp's Python parser (gyp.py) spawning unexpected child processes during npm install, indicative of GYP command-expansion abuse used by the Miasma v2 / Phantom Gyp worm (June 2026)
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/exploring-binding-gyp-npm-build-system
  - https://semgrep.dev/blog/2026/miasma-v2-self-spreading-npm-worm-now-uses-malicious-bindinggyp-file-and-compromises-57-packages/
  - https://www.endorlabs.com/learn/malicious-payload-in-ai-sdk-ollama-npm-package
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1059.007
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_python_gyp:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'gyp.py'
      - 'node-gyp'
      - 'binding.gyp'
  suspicious_child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  suspicious_child_cmdline:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'index.js'
      - '__subclasses__'
      - 'catch_warnings'
      - 'echo stub.c'
      - "__import__('os')"
      - 'pymod_do_main'
  filter_compilers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cl.exe'
      - '\link.exe'
      - '\cmake.exe'
      - '\msbuild.exe'
      - '\gcc.exe'
      - '\clang.exe'
      - '\make.exe'
      - '\nmake.exe'
  condition: parent_python_gyp and (suspicious_child_image or suspicious_child_cmdline) and not filter_compilers
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate packages whose binding.gyp uses <!(node ...) for non-malicious build-time configuration (e.g. node-pre-gyp version probing)
  - Developers manually invoking node-gyp rebuild for native add-on debugging
level: high

let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowSec = 60;
let Reenroll = W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where csMethod == "POST"
    | where csUriStem matches regex @"^/api/v1/hosts/[^/]+/reenroll/?$"
    | where scStatus in (200, 201)
    | extend VictimHostId = extract(@"/api/v1/hosts/([^/]+)/reenroll", 1, csUriStem)
    | project ReenrollTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, cIP, csUserName, VictimHostId, ReenrollAgent = csUserAgent;
let Enroll = W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where csMethod == "POST"
    | where csUriStem matches regex @"^/api/v1/enroll/?$"
    | where scStatus in (200, 201)
    | project EnrollTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, cIP, EnrollAgent = csUserAgent;
Reenroll
| join kind=inner Enroll on cIP, Computer
| where EnrollTime between (ReenrollTime .. ReenrollTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EnrollTime, ReenrollTime)
| extend CVE = "CVE-2026-47724"
| project ReenrollTime, EnrollTime, DelaySec, Computer, cIP, csUserName, VictimHostId, ReenrollAgent, EnrollAgent, CVE
| order by ReenrollTime desc

| tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method="POST" Web.uri_path="/api/v1/hosts/*/reenroll" Web.status IN (200,201) by _time Web.src Web.user Web.dest Web.uri_path span=1s
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| rex field=uri_path "/api/v1/hosts/(?<victim_host_id>[^/]+)/reenroll"
| eval reenroll_time=_time, reenroll_count=count
| fields - count
| join type=inner src dest [
    | tstats summariesonly=t count as enroll_count from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method="POST" Web.uri_path="/api/v1/enroll" Web.status IN (200,201) by _time Web.src Web.dest span=1s
    | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
    | eval enroll_time=_time
    | fields enroll_time enroll_count src dest
  ]
| where enroll_time >= reenroll_time AND enroll_time <= reenroll_time + 60
| eval delay_sec=enroll_time - reenroll_time, cve="CVE-2026-47724"
| stats min(reenroll_time) as first_reenroll values(victim_host_id) as victim_hosts min(delay_sec) as min_delay_sec max(delay_sec) as max_delay_sec count by src user dest cve
| where count >= 1
| sort - first_reenroll

title: Vulnerable cordova-plugin-inappbrowser install (CVE-2026-47430)
id: 8e6c4b8a-3d2a-4e6f-9d7b-1c0e2a4b8d6a
description: |
  Detects npm / yarn / pnpm / cordova / ionic CLI invocations that install
  cordova-plugin-inappbrowser in a version range vulnerable to CVE-2026-47430
  (3.1.0 through 6.0.0). Pinned safe versions (>=6.0.1) are excluded.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q42j-x8rq-pjg6
author: Detection engineering
date: 2026/06/14
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.001
  - cve.2026.47430
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\npm.exe'
      - '\npm.cmd'
      - '\npx.exe'
      - '\yarn.exe'
      - '\pnpm.exe'
      - '\cordova.cmd'
      - '\cordova.exe'
      - '\ionic.cmd'
      - '\node.exe'
  selection_pkg:
    CommandLine|contains: 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser'
  selection_action:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' install'
      - ' add'
      - ' plugin add'
  filter_safe_pin:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser@6.0.1'
      - 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser@6.0.2'
      - 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser@6.1'
      - 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser@7'
  filter_uninstall:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' uninstall'
      - ' remove '
      - ' rm '
      - ' list '
      - ' ls '
  condition: selection_proc and selection_pkg and selection_action and not (filter_safe_pin or filter_uninstall)
level: medium
falsepositives:
  - Developer intentionally pinning to a still-vulnerable version for compatibility testing
  - Security researcher reproducing the CVE in a sandbox repo
  - CI agent restoring a legacy package-lock.json that still references 5.x
